extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit organizations, institutions, and individuals seeking funding from the Ford Foundation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural rules for organizations and individuals seeking grants from the Ford Foundation, including what the foundation funds, submission rules, anti-fraud notices, and where to find awarded grants and program information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Ford Foundation programs
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund a range of organizations around the world that align with our programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advancing justice starts with supporting the individuals and institutions working tirelessly to address the underlying drivers of inequality — projects should address inequality and align with the Foundation's programmatic priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: No unsolicited grant proposals accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note we do not accept any unsolicited grant proposals by mail, email or phone. For more information please visit our grant opportunities page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send proposals via mail, email, or phone; use the Foundation's published grant opportunities page for information on how to apply or engage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware of scams — the Foundation never charges fees
rubrics_metrics.description: There are individuals using Ford’s name without authorization suggesting that funds are forthcoming if they pay a fee. These messages are fraudulent. Please note that the foundation never charges a fee in connection with its grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should treat any request for payment or fees as fraud and not provide funds or personal information in response to unsolicited messages claiming Ford funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use grants database to view active and past awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Our database displays active grants from the Ford Foundation. To delve deeper into our past grantmaking, annual reports from 1950-2012 can be viewed in the governance and financial statements archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the grants database and archival annual reports to research who the Foundation has funded, identify relevant grants, and understand historical priorities and award patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority: Building Institutions and Networks (BUILD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because tackling inequality requires endurance, we have dedicated $2 billion of our budget to help strengthen social justice institutions. We call this effort BUILD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The BUILD initiative is a stated funding priority emphasizing institutional strengthening and network-building; organizations focused on long-term institutional capacity may be a fit for this effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited funds — consider other philanthropic organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Because our funds are limited, we welcome you to learn more about other philanthropic organizations that may be able to further your work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your work may not align with Ford's current priorities or capacity, proactively research and approach other funders who may be better positioned to support your project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand the Foundation's grantmaking process
rubrics_metrics.description: How does an endowment work? How does grantmaking help fuel social change? These videos break down the essentials of grantmaking and explain how the foundation operates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should review available explanatory materials (videos and resources) to learn how Ford's grantmaking works and what to expect from its processes and priorities.
